description: 适用于系统综述与 Meta 分析；检查主要章节并提示注册、清单、流程图和材料开放。
descriptionEn: For systematic reviews and meta-analyses; checks major sections and flags registration, checklist, flow diagram, and material availability.

rules.message: 系统综述需要可识别的方法章节。
rules.messageEn: A systematic review needs an identifiable Methods section.

rules.message: 系统综述需要可识别的结果章节。
rules.messageEn: A systematic review needs an identifiable Results section.

rules.message: 请报告综述注册信息与方案位置，或明确说明未注册、未制定方案。
rules.messageEn: Report review registration and protocol access, or explicitly state that the review was not registered or no protocol was prepared.

rules.message: 请完成 PRISMA 2020 官方清单和适用的流程图；本检查不替代 27 项清单。
rules.messageEn: Complete the official PRISMA 2020 checklist and applicable flow diagram; this check does not replace the 27-item checklist.
